$comment: Copy to <project>/.claude/praxarch.json to override praxarch defaults for this project. Every key is optional — omit anything you don't want to override. Project config merges over global (~/.claude/praxarch/config.json), which merges over built-in defaults. To retune a role's MODEL for one project, don't use this file — copy the role's agent file into <project>/.claude/agents/ and change its model frontmatter; project agents shadow user agents by name.

verifyGate.$comment: Thresholds that trigger the Stop-hook verification requirement — a diff is non-trivial at minChangedLines changed lines, or at minChangedFiles files once it also has minChangedLinesForFiles changed lines — and paths excluded from the size calculation. The three thresholds override wholesale. ignorePatterns are ADDED to the defaults ["package-lock.json", "pnpm-lock.yaml", "yarn.lock", ".min.js", "dist/", ".claude/plans/", ".claude/handoffs/"]. verdictRoles are ADDED to the defaults ["verifier", "checker", "plan-reviewer"]: roles whose trailing JSON verdict telemetry records for the gate — add a custom review role here so its review satisfies the gate; the role's report must end with the verifier template's JSON verdict block.

routeGuard.$comment: strict:false turns hard denials into warnings. securityKeywords are ADDED to the built-in set that forces routing to security-executor. Keywords match whole words case-insensitively; end one with * to match a stem (e.g. "tokeniz*" matches tokenize/tokenizer/tokenization). knownRoles are ADDED to the built-in eleven roles and treated the same way: their model comes from agent frontmatter, so calls to them must omit `model` — list agents praxarch doesn't install here (e.g. roles from another plugin) instead of passing `model` to satisfy the ad-hoc rule. reviewRoles are ADDED to the default ["verifier", "checker", "plan-reviewer", "planner", "claude-code-guide"]: read-only roles exempt from the security-keyword redirect (reviewers legitimately mention auth/secrets when reviewing security code, and claude-code-guide answers questions from Anthropic's docs; Explore stays off the default because it searches the codebase). The exemption applies only to a role that is also a known role (built-in or knownRoles), so a custom reviewer must be listed in BOTH knownRoles and reviewRoles. reviewRoles bypasses the security-keyword check entirely. For every other role a security-keyword match is a hard deny, except an ad-hoc call (no defined role) that passes a model at or above security-executor's tier (opus or fable), which gets a warning (allow + systemMessage) instead.
